other_conditions: Applicant must be born in Puducherry or have at least five years of continuous residence in Puducherry before the application date
Research book must be at least 150 pages long
Submitted work must be a first edition printed and published by 31 December of the specified year
Work must have been published in the calendar year preceding the award year but not in the previous year
Essays, dissertations, novels, short stories, poetry, drama, travelogues, and collections of essays are not eligible
A previous awardee cannot apply for the next four years
Submitted text must not be an abridgment, adaptation, translation, or paraphrase of another work
The thesis/editorial work must be in Tamil language only
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 along with an award and certificate.
